title: fix(app-shell): refresh a record's activity feed and its count after a save
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBCR7M79mqrrkKsupzFEpuVj)_

Fixes #30035

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 记录页（含抽屉）的「动态」在保存后就地重读：编辑弹窗保存、动作、撤销让这条记录失效时，动态的读取跟着重跑，按打开时问过的那几项（讨论、活动行、动态总数）再问一次记录页接口，于是新写的活动行和服务端的计数一起到位，不用刷新。开了 `trackHistory` 的对象，字段变更也跟着重读。
- **为什么改:** 实测是第三种情况：保存确实让本记录的失效计数加一（页脚「更新人 … 刚刚」就是这样刷新的），服务端也在更新返回前就写好了 `sys_activity`（审计写入挂在 `afterUpdate`，引擎 await 完才返回），但动态的读取 effect 根本不看这个计数，只用打开时那份页面负载。
- **风险与回滚:** 只动 `@object-ui/app-shell` 的记录页视图和负载辅助函数，无 spec、无服务端改动，不轮询。每次本记录失效多一个窄请求（`related: []`，只带动态三项）。回滚 = revert。
- **先看:** `RecordDetailView.tsx` 的动态读取 effect（`openedHere` / `feedStreamsReread` 那段和依赖数组里的 `recordInvalidationNonce`）；`recordPagePayload.ts` 新增的 `recordPageStreamsRequestOf`；测试 `RecordDetailView.timelineCount-28737.test.tsx` 末尾的 objectstack#30035 describe。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.timelineCount-28737.test.tsx`，预期 9/9 通过；在 app-crm 上打开一条商机，编辑 → 改金额 → 更新，不刷新，动态计数加一、列表出现「更新了 商机 …：金额」。
- **需要你做的:** 无，席位落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **The record feed re-reads on this record's invalidation.** The feed effect in `RecordDetailView` now lists `recordInvalidationNonce` among its dependencies, so a save through the edit dialog, an action, an undo or a ⟳ reads the 动态 stream again in place (AGENTS.md #8 / objectui#2269: refresh data, don't rebuild UI). The record-load effect already re-read the record on the same nonce; the feed did not, which is the whole defect.
- **The re-read asks what the open asked.** Once the record changed after the open (the open's recorded generation no longer equals the current one), the feed no longer takes its rows from the open's payload. It asks `getRecordPage` again with `recordPageStreamsRequestOf(streams)`: the open's own stream parts (`discussion`, `activity.top`, `timeline`) and nothing else (`related: []`, no `explain`, `fieldAccess`, `approvals` or `expand`; those readers re-read on the same change themselves). The answer flows through the existing `recordPageComments` / `recordPageActivity` / `recordPageTimeline` path, so the stream's count stays the server's (objectstack#28737) instead of falling back to counting held rows, and a busy record keeps its true total. Every run of the effect at one invalidation count joins one ask (`feedStreamsReread`). A dataSource without `getRecordPage` keeps the feed's own `sys_comment` / `sys_activity` reads, as before.
- **The 动态 tab's window stays held.** A re-read merges the newest rows into what the feed already holds, so a feed that already read the window does not set the peek flag again and does not ask the window a second time.
- **Field changes follow the same nonce.** The `sys_audit_log` read behind the stream's field-change entries gets `recordInvalidationNonce` in its dependency list too, so on an object with `enable.trackHistory` the new field change shows as well.

## Why

The card asked to tell three cases apart. Readings on `origin/main` `c23501b2b`:

1. **Does the edit dialog's save bump this record's nonce? Yes.** The dialog's save goes through the adapter (`POST /api/v1/batch` with one atomic `update` for `crm_opportunity`, measured live), whose MutationEvent `useMutationInvalidationBridge` (mounted once in `AppContent`) puts on the bus as `{ objectName, recordId }`. The record-load effect re-read the record on it, which is why the footer read 更新人 … 刚刚 while 动态 stayed stale.
2. **Does the server write the activity row after the response? No.** plugin-audit registers `writeAudit` on `afterUpdate`, which awaits `persistAuditTrailRow` (the `sys_audit_log` row, then its `sys_activity` mirror). The engine's update awaits `triggerHooks('afterUpdate', …)` before it answers. So the row exists when the save answers, and the late-row case is not real here: no late-row test, no realtime subscription, no polling.
3. **Does the feed effect depend on the nonce? No — this is the case.** Its dependency list was `dataSource, objectName, pureRecordId, currentUser, feedsEnabled, activitiesEnabled, feedFetchKey, reactionStore, feedWanted, feedPlanReady, feedRetryNonce`; nothing re-ran it after a write. Even if it had re-run, it would have taken the rows and the count from the open's payload (`recordPageRead.current`), which the layout effect does not re-ask on an invalidation.

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in the shared real-adapter harness `RecordDetailView.timelineCount-28737.test.tsx` (StrictMode, held transport, the console's mutation bridge mounted beside the view):

- `the record page: the count and the rows hold the save's activity row without a reload`: open with one activity row and a served count of 2, the server then holds the update's row and a count of 3, `ds.update(...)` (the edit dialog's door); the chip reads 3, the new row's text is on screen, and exactly one `POST …/page` went out with body `{ related: [], discussion: true, activity: { top: 5 }, timeline: { … } }`.
- `the drawer: …`: the same with `embedded`.
- `a change to another record of the object reads nothing again`: an update to `c2` sends no page ask.

<details><summary>Run, ablation (two legs) and the wider suite</summary>

- Harness file: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 9 passed (9)` (the 6 existing objectstack#28737 / #29878 cases plus the 3 above).
- Ablation leg 1, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 → 0, restored blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty): drop `recordInvalidationNonce` from the feed effect's dependencies → both save cases red, `AssertionError: expected '2' to be '3'`, `Tests 2 failed | 7 passed (9)`.
- Ablation leg 2: keep the dependency, but take the open's payload on the re-run (`fromPage = openedHere`) → the same two red, `expected '2' to be '3'`. So re-running alone is not enough; the re-ask is load-bearing.
- Every test file under `ui/packages/app-shell/src` and `ui/apps/console/src` that imports `RecordDetailView` or `recordPagePayload` (192 files, selected by `grep -rlE`): `Test Files 192 passed (192)`, `Tests 1319 passed (1319)`. The rest of Test UI is CI's.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. `npx eslint` on the three touched files from the package dir: 0 errors (134 pre-existing `no-explicit-any` warnings). `pnpm run check:new-line-citations` (ui): `0 new citation(s)`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Live check on `examples/app-crm`** (full build, `pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh`, Console from `ui/apps/console` via Vite so it serves this branch's src, zh-CN, admin): 商机 record page, 编辑 → 金额 110000 → 115000 → 更新, no reload: 动态 **0 → 1**, row 更新了 商机 "Globex — Analytics Pack"：金额 刚刚. Drawer (`?recordId=` over the list): 动态 **1 → 2** on a second save of the same record, both rows listed. Before-leg on another record with the fix ablated (src mutated through `ablation-replace --hold`, restored after): 动态 **0 → 0** after the save while `GET /api/v1/data/sys_activity` for that record already answered `total: 1`, the card's symptom.
- **Extra request per invalidation.** After a save the page now sends one narrow `POST /data/OBJECT/ID/page` for the streams. The route answers the record with it (its read gate), so the record is read once more than strictly needed; the alternative, the feed's own `sys_comment` + `sys_comment_reaction` + `sys_activity` reads, is three requests and loses the served count.
- **Observed, not changed:** on `main` the open's full page payload is also asked again a moment after a save (the layout effect re-runs on a plan input that moves after the write; seen in the before-leg too). The feed does not take it. Noted here only; no defect claimed.
- `origin/main` moved 3 commits since the base (`d79eecfe`, `614e831b`, `d59a1eb4`); none touches `RecordDetailView.tsx`, `recordPagePayload.ts`, plugin-detail, data-objectstack or the record-page route, so the branch was not merged before opening.
